entries.3f3c419b4ef8bfaa: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥132,986 million, down 56.5% from ¥305,384 million in the previous year. The results of ONE, an equity-method affiliate responsible for the container shipping business, are reflected in the financial statements through the equity method. The company names steel raw materials, car carriers and LNG carriers as businesses that drive growth, and its policy is to allocate management resources to them intensively.
entries.4e41983f1b0b5647: This business provides scheduled transport by container ships. In July 2017, Ocean Network Express Holdings Ltd. and OCEAN NETWORK EXPRESS PTE. LTD. (ONE) were established for the purpose of integrating the scheduled container shipping businesses of Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd. and Nippon Yusen Kabushiki Kaisha; ONE began operations in April 2018. As of March 31, 2026, Ocean Network Express Holdings Ltd. is an equity-method affiliate with a voting rights ownership ratio of 31.0%, and ONE is a 100.0%-owned subsidiary of it (not a consolidated subsidiary). For the fiscal year ended March 2026, cargo volumes fluctuated temporarily under the influence of U.S. trade policy and the Middle East situation but remained firm over the full year, while the oversupply caused by a large number of new vessels being completed did not ease, and average freight rates were below the previous year's level. Revenue for this segment is not presented separately.
entries.5263103c4688ec0f: This business handles cargo handling and warehousing at ports, towage, arrangement of international cargo transport, and logistics for finished vehicles. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, container terminal handling volume in the domestic logistics and port business, the number of towage jobs in the towage business and warehousing volume in the warehousing business were each firm. In the international logistics business, some cargo movements, mainly automobile-related cargo in the air transport of the forwarding business, were sluggish, while semiconductor transport volume increased. In the finished vehicle logistics business, new vehicle sales, which affect handling volumes at ports in Australia, were at the same level as the previous year, and transport and storage volumes remained generally stable. Main consolidated subsidiaries in this business include Daitō Corporation, Nitō Butsuryū Co., Ltd. and Shīgēto Corporation, which are port transport businesses; Nitō Tagu Co., Ltd., a towage business; K Line Logistics Ltd., an air freight agency business; and Nihon Kōsoku Yusō Co., Ltd., a trucking business (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue for this segment is not presented separately.

entries.6f790ddb46057262: Dry Bulk transports iron ore, bauxite, coal and other cargo using large and medium and small ships. Energy Resources operates LNG carriers, LPG carriers, electric-power coal carriers, large crude oil tankers, drillships (offshore drilling vessels) and FPSOs (floating production, storage and offloading units) under medium- to long-term charter contracts. Product Logistics consists of the automobile carrier business, which transports automobiles on car carriers; logistics businesses such as port cargo handling, warehousing, tugboat services and arrangement of international cargo transport (forwarding); the coastal and domestic cargo shipping business (including ferries); and the container shipping business. It is also engaged in businesses aimed at decarbonization, such as the liquefied CO2 carrier 'NORTHERN PIONEER' (completed November 2024) and offshore work support vessel business related to offshore wind power generation.
entries.6fb62933322e6401: This is a segment consisting solely of the dry bulk business, transporting cargo such as iron ore, bauxite and coal on large vessels and on mid-sized and small vessels. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥292,783 million (28.8% of group revenue, down 9.2% year on year), making it the 2nd-largest business among the reportable segments. Large vessel market conditions remained generally firm against a backdrop of firm demand for iron ore and bauxite, while mid-sized and small vessel market conditions softened at times in the first half due to weak demand for coal transport, but recovered from early 2026 and remained firm. Main constituent companies are Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha, Ltd., K LINE BULK SHIPPING (UK) LIMITED, K LINE PTE LTD and K Line (India) Shipping Private Limited (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.74f6d50861b5fc6b: This segment includes the LNG carrier business, liquefied gas business, power business, crude oil and products business, and energy business strategy. Vessels including LNG carriers, LPG carriers, power coal carriers, large crude oil carriers, drillships (offshore drilling vessels) and FPSOs (floating oil and gas production, storage and offloading facilities) are operating smoothly under medium- to long-term charter contracts. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥100,666 million (9.9% of group revenue, down 1.2% year on year), falling below the previous year due to effects including currency movements. Main constituent companies are Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha, Ltd., K Line Wind Service Ltd. (offshore support vessel business for offshore wind power generation), K LINE ENERGY SHIPPING (UK) LIMITED, K LINE DRILLING/OFFSHORE HOLDING, INC., K LINE (TAIWAN) LTD. and K LINE PTE LTD (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.88ace6ddff4c46b1: This segment consists of the coastal business and the domestic business, which comprises ferry, scheduled liner and tramp shipping services. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, in the coastal business, steel volume declined year on year, while biomass fuel and bulk cargo increased, and overall transport volume exceeded the previous year's level. In the domestic business, ferry transport increased for trucks, passenger cars and passengers alike, with passenger cars and passengers performing particularly strongly. Scheduled liner transport was firm on the Tomakomai route, but overall volume fell below the previous year due to factors including rough weather and poor crop harvests. In tramp shipping, transport of limestone declined, while coal transport and general cargo ships were firm. Kawasaki Kinkai Kisen Co., Ltd., which is involved in this business, was established in May 1966 by separating the company's domestic division and became a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange in June 2022. Revenue for this segment is not presented separately.
entries.90806965ec87f48c: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,018,364 million, down 2.8% from ¥1,047,944 million in the previous fiscal year (ended March 2025). Net sales from external customers were ¥616,498 million for Product Logistics (60.5% of the total, up 0.6% year on year), ¥292,783 million for Dry Bulk (28.8%, down 9.2%), ¥100,666 million for Energy Resources (9.9%, down 1.2%) and ¥8,415 million for Other (0.8%, down 22.2%). The decrease in Energy Resources revenue is explained as due to foreign exchange effects and other factors. The shipping revenue of the filing company is divided into ocean freight, charter fees and other items (terminal-related revenue, ship management contract revenue, etc.).

entries.fc8c891ddcc6ca99: This business transports automobiles using car carriers. The history section records the combined bulk and car carrier Dai-ichi Toyota Maru (completed November 1968), Japan's first car carrier, named PURE CAR CARRIER (PCC), Dai-jū Toyota Maru (completed July 1970), the next-generation environmentally friendly car carrier DRIVE GREEN HIGHWAY (completed February 2016), and the next-generation environmentally friendly LNG-fueled car carrier CENTURY HIGHWAY GREEN (completed March 2021). For the fiscal year ended March 2026, car sales in each country were generally firm overall, while the impact of additional U.S. tariffs and the deterioration of the Middle East situation at period-end led to changes in vessel deployment and higher operating costs such as fuel. Revenue for this segment is not presented separately.
